## Setup (do this before publishing)

1. **Alerts channel (optional).** The Alert node posts to the global variable `$vars.alerts_channel` (a chat channel id). Create that variable under Workflows → Variables, or delete the **Alert: list changed** node if you do not want chat alerts.
2. **Edit EXTRAS / EXCLUDE / SAFE** at the top of the **Build list** code node. EXTRAS starts empty — add any domains you want blocked on top of upstream. EXCLUDE keeps simplelogin.com and passmail.net unblocked by default. SAFE never blocks major providers (Gmail, Outlook, …).
3. **Error workflow (optional).** In Settings, point Error workflow at a workflow that has an error trigger, so a failed run alerts you.
4. **Timezone.** Schedule cron runs in this workflow's timezone (Settings → Timezone). The default cron is `30 4 * * 1` (Monday 04:30). Change the expression or the timezone to match your local Monday morning.
5. **Run once by hand** (⋮ → Execute workflow) and check Executions. The first run can add thousands of domains to `blocked_email_domains`.
6. **Publish** when the dry run looks right.

The setting is visible under Admin → Settings → `blocked_email_domains`. Upstream list: https://github.com/disposable-email-domains/disposable-email-domains (not bundled in this file).
